question: Who among the following was a Shehnai player and performed at Delhi's Red Fort as the Indian flag unfurled at the hour of India's independence on 15 August 1947?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bismillah Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bismillah Khan** was a legendary Indian musician and is regarded as one of the greatest players of the **Shehnai**.
 
• He performed at the historic moment of India’s independence on **15 August 1947** at the **Red Fort** in Delhi when the **Indian flag was unfurled**.
 
• His performance marked the celebration of independence and symbolized India's rich cultural heritage.
 
• Bismillah Khan was born in **1916** in a family of court musicians in **Dumraon, Bihar**.
 
• He popularized the **Shehnai**, an instrument that was traditionally played in temples and weddings, elevating it to the status of a concert instrument.
 
• He received the prestigious **Bharat Ratna**, India’s highest civilian award, in **2001** for his contribution to Indian music.
 
• His music was deeply rooted in the **Banaras Gharana** and reflected the ethos of Indian classical traditions.
 
• Bismillah Khan was known for his humility and dedication to his art, often referring to music as his religion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ramnad Raghavan**__

 __
 
• Ramnad Raghavan was a renowned **Mridangam player** associated with Carnatic music.
 
• He contributed significantly to South Indian classical music but was not related to the historic performance at India’s independence.
 
• He was born in **Tamil Nadu** and was known for his collaborations with legendary Carnatic musicians.
 
 
 
• **Hemant Kumar**__
 __
 
• Hemant Kumar was a prominent **playback singer and music composer** in the Indian film industry.
 
• He was known for his contribution to Hindi and Bengali music, but he was not associated with the Shehnai or the performance at the **Red Fort**.
 
• He composed music for iconic films such as **Nagin** and **Bees Saal Baad**.
 
 
 
• **Ali Akbar Khan**__
 
 
• Ali Akbar Khan was a legendary **Sarod player** and one of the most celebrated figures in Indian classical music.
 
• He was a disciple of **Baba Allauddin Khan** and helped popularize Indian classical music internationally.
 
• Though highly influential in Indian music, he was not connected to the Shehnai or the independence day performance.
